classification: limited post-hoc screen of currently materialized independent strategy dimensions for a third equity profit source
purpose: R338 could not run because the R257 QRS factor is absent from the current alt_hs300 schema. R339 screens only strategy definitions whose required columns are verified present before any screen return is read.

common_execution.sleeve_role_if_selected: third C sleeve in a subsequent separately preregistered portfolio test

eligibility_gates.D1: strategy loads and produces a full common-window curve at both 2x and 5x
eligibility_gates.E1: 5x total return >=10% over the common window
eligibility_gates.E4: maximum pairwise daily-return correlation with existing A and B <=0.80
eligibility_gates.E6: 5x top1 net contribution <=60% and top5 net contribution <=150%

selection_rule: If one or more candidates pass E1-E7, select the eligible candidate with highest 5x Sharpe; ties go to lower maximum correlation with A/B. If none pass, record a negative screen and do not force a third sleeve. No threshold may change after results.
anti_cherry_pick: Candidate list is fixed before running any candidate return.
No strategy parameter, holding period, stop-loss, TopN or cost override is changed.
Only 2x and 5x are run; 3x/4x are not candidate-selection inputs.
The selected C sleeve must be re-tested in a separately preregistered three-sleeve portfolio round.
known_limitations: The screen is in-sample and post-hoc.
Several candidates previously produced weak or negative event/factor results; they remain in the fixed screen to avoid selecting only past winners.
Standalone concentration gates are weaker than the final portfolio C2-C4 gates and are only intended to reject obvious one-name sleeves.
Current industry and fund/event snapshots are not full vendor PIT reconstructions.
